subject.title: Gemini models output inline buttons as raw JSON text instead of using tool format

question: Should OpenClaw support a narrow raw bracketed button JSON fallback for Gemini final replies, or require provider/tool prompting to emit typed message-tool presentation buttons only?
rationale: The current source proves the structured-only gap, but raw final-text parsing would expand the model-visible message contract and affect transcript plus Telegram presentation behavior.

options.title: Accept Narrow Raw Fallback
options.body: Allow constrained raw-button parsing only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Telegram/Gemini proof.

options.title: Retarget To Typed Routing
options.body: Reject raw final-text parsing and keep the fix focused on Gemini/provider prompting so buttons are emitted through the structured message tool contract.

options.title: Hold For Live Repro First
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause implementation acceptance until a maintainer or reporter supplies a live Gemini/Telegram reproduction.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Raw Fallback
recommendation.body: Allow constrained raw-button parsing only after the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Telegram/Gemini proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked PR requests steipete's review and the decision crosses typed presentation, Telegram controls, and final-reply product behavior.
